rewrite_rule: Each query is a natural-language information need derived from the abstract's meaning, not a copy of the title. Avoid proper names and distinctive title tokens where possible; allow at most ~2 content-word overlaps with the title (stopwords ignored). Labels remain structural: relevant doc = the document whose abstract motivated the paraphrase (title→doc ownership), NEVER from running the embedder under test.
labeling_method: relevant_ids assigned at fixture authoring from which document the paraphrase was written about. Independent of nomic-embed-text or any model under test.
